Name: Kaelen Portrait Remake - Rupnan Collection
Author: Lerial0
Description:
[b]Overview[/b]
This mod brings a more handsome and refreshed portrait remake for [b]Kaelen[/b] from the [i]Rupnan Collection[/i]! With refined art style and more charming expressions, Kaelen looks even more dashing and stylish in-game.
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]A Major Glow-Up:[/b] A meticulously crafted new portrait for Kaelen that retains his core personality while significantly upgrading his overall look.[/*]
[*][b]Visual Refinement:[/b] Replaces the original portraits with finer details and improved expressions.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]You [b]MUST[/b] first download and install the original main mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51711]Rupnan Collection[/url].[/*]
[/list][b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Ensure you have successfully installed the original [b]Rupnan Collection[/b] main mod.[/*]
[*]Download this new portrait file, extract it, and [b]overwrite[/b] the original files.[/*]
[/list][b] Overview (簡介)[/b]
這個模組為《Rupnan Collection》中的角色 [b]Kaelen[/b] 帶來了更帥氣的全新肖像重製！透過精修的畫風與更迷人的神態，讓 Kaelen 變得更加帥氣有型。
[b]Features (特色)[/b]
[list]
[*][b]帥氣升級（Glow-up）：[/b] 為 Kaelen 量身打造的精緻新肖像，保留角色核心特質的同時，帥度全面提升。[/*]
[*][b]視覺優化：[/b] 以更細緻的筆觸與表情，替換原本的肖像。[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements (前置需求)[/b]
[list]
[*]你[b]必須[/b]先下載並安裝原始的主模組：[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51711]Rupnan Collection[/url]。[/*]
[/list][b]Installation (安裝方式)[/b]
[list=1]
[*]請確保你已經成功安裝原始的 [b]Rupnan Collection[/b] 主模組。[/*]
[*]下載此新繪像檔案，解壓縮後並覆蓋原檔。[/*]
[/list]
